xP3

dataset.xp3

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual primary creator card/repository protocol and source paper construction/limitations/manifestation reads establish one named derived xP3 dataset family with multilingual additions and prompting/processing protocols, not merely an unchangedP3mirror. Original qualified directsubjectfacts retain their actual3distinctrolecurrentdigestreviews. Earlier stricter independence hold is preserved historically and corrected explicitly: frozenBrequires distinct source-backed family identity, not disjoint examples. P3source overlap and reused constituent datasets remain disclosed; no new independenthumanannotation or example-disjointness claim. xP3mt/xP3all/xP3megds/xP3x are creator-named machine-translated/heldout-eval/processed/expandedvariants of this family, with no extrafamilycredit here. Keep paper/card13trainingtasks versus16includingevaluation distinction and source-specific countversions; no corpus recount,114pagepromptcatalogaudit or experiment/model/contamination replication. Apachecardmetadata is not blanket clearance of allupstreamlicenses. Full_source means substantive available primary family construction/evaluation/identity/version/limits documentation, not all sourcepayloads or unseen appendices.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

xP3 · documents: The pinned xP3 card distinguishes 13 training task types in 46 languages from the evaluation-inclusive 16-task variant, machine-translated-prompt variant and processed training format.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.dataset.xp3.composite-and-variant-units

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Variants, languages, prompt templates and the later xP3x extension do not create extra selected families; strict independence from upstream P3 and other constituents remains unresolved.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

xP3 · documents: The paper’s rank-classification evaluations use five random prompts and median per-language scores; it notes unintentional exposure to supposedly unseen languages, limited language coverage and shorter-generation bias after multitask fine-tuning.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.dataset.xp3.evaluation-and-limits

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • These model experiments do not establish universal gains for corpus users or complete language/task contamination freedom. Most of the paper’s prompt catalogue was outside this bounded read.
